notes: All sounds are synthesised and original; no third-party samples or licences.
WAV files are final: do not low-pass, bit-reduce, resample or otherwise re-process them.
Files ending in _loop are seamless loops; enable looping on import.
UI sounds are stereo; gameplay/world sounds are mono for positional playback.
cooldown / max_voices / pitch_var / priority are suggestions in the style of events.json.
